scope: Paper proof only: research/prime_field_ic_closure_20261112/finish/theorem/PROOF.md, checked by one adversarial checker ('sound with gaps'; reading in research/notes/index-calculus/PRIME_FIELD_IC_CLOSURE_20261112.md section 3.3). Gaps: the univariate case assumes Delta_R is the same for every target (at most about 2^m special x(R) break this); literal XL on the graph presentation has a gap (not an H-basis). Model-relative: the checker's msolve F4 runs solve univariate bases at degree d+2 (m=2) and d+8 (m=3) against XL's 2d+2 and 3d+9, so the closures hold within XL only and no F4 lower bound is known. Lean covers K1 (k1_root_bound, |B| <= 2 deg f) and the degree-needed lemmas for literal XL; Lemma 4, Lemma 6 and Theorem B are not formalised. Lemma 4 matched the literal Macaulay matrix on 80/80 re-run toy rows.
statement: Theorem B (prime-field index calculus, same restricted XL/Macaulay model as Theorem A): for a factor base with no auxiliary variables, cut out by one univariate polynomial f(x) of degree d (|B| <= 2d), XL at any degree has expected cost E[cost] >= n*C(m+d-Delta, m)/C(2d+m-1, m), which tends to 2^-m * n: exponent 1, against Pollard rho's 1/2. This closes, inside the model only, the fixed-degree root base (A5), the APS vanishing-polynomial base (A6-APS) and parametrised rational-map bases (A4). For the image of a rational map of degree e (graph presentation), the bound holds for XL^J only through a checker-supplied repair that is not in PROOF.md, with constant (2(e+1))^-m * n, so exponent 1 only when e = n^o(1); it is vacuous for composed or iterated maps (e = 2^k, a PKM chain written without auxiliary variables) and for power-map / mu_n bases of large e.
